title: MV Minor Bug Associated with Himeworks Party Manager

posts.author: Piyan Glupak
posts.body:
I found an interesting feature that may affect users of Himeworks Party Manager:
https://himeworks.com/2016/02/party-manager-mv/
If there is an extra, inactive party on a map, and the active party transfers from the map using a common event, one of the events of the destination map will not appear. This bug doesn't seem to occur with normal map-event transfers from the starting map.
The missing event is the destination map event numbered 2 higher than the last event of the starting map.
My current project has a separate party for dead party members, that is usually empty. That party is located in the sole temple that does resurrection. Also in the temple, is a mirror portal that gives access to towns previously visited. The mirror portal uses a common event to let the player choose a destination, and then transfers them. (There are other, similar mirror portals in other locations.)
I solved this in my game by moving the mirror portal to a different room (i.e. another map) off the main part of the temple.
Other users of this extremely useful plugin may wish to be aware of this bug. The plugin was written quite a while ago, for an earlier version of MV. I understand that the author might no longer be active in the RPG Maker community, so support or updates might be unlikely
EDIT
: 12th February 2025. After more investigation, I don't think that it has anything to do with common events. This problem isn't always noticed during playtesting - do you check all the expected events are there when you move to a new map? If it is an Inn sign, a purely scenic animal or part of a waterfall you wouldn't always look for it.
To get around this bug, I suggest that you make the event on the destination map numbered 2 more than the last one in the map with the inactive party purely scenic and unimportant, for instance, butterflies are pretty and don't impede the player if the event priority is set "Above characters", for instance.
